<observations>
Date: May 4 - May 10, 2026
* 🔴 User kitchen remodel project: Contractor quote is $21,250; appliance allowance is $6,300. Rule: always send photos before opening walls. Pets include dog Bella and cats Whiskers and Luna.
* 🔴 Major material & fixture selections: Modern island with integrated sink, $515 undermount sink with disposal, FlowDesign 'Eclipse' matte black faucet & soap dispenser, brushed nickel hardware, LumiBright $275 dimmable RGB lighting kit, StoneCraft waterfall quartz countertop ($4,200), and TileMosaic herringbone backsplash ($1,150).
* 🔴 Additional selections: Pull-out pantry drawer, ColorWave 'Arctic Fog' low-VOC paint, FaucetWorks pot-filler ($420), ChillBox compact fridge ($1,120), and GreenThumb self-watering herb kit ($85).

Date: May 13 - May 21, 2026
* 🔴 Finalized cabinet and surface choices: Oakridge 'LunaSeries' matte white cabinets ($1,850/ea, delivery June 5) and StoneCraft 'RiverEdge' quartz countertops ($3,200/unit, delivery June 8).
* 🔴 Added lighting and appliances: LuminaLighting 'Nimbus' brushed nickel pendants ($89/ea), ChillBox C12 12-bottle wine cooler, built-in coffee station, and EcoTemp Pro thermostat (installing June 15).
* 🟡 Schedule & Permits: Plumbing permit PR-2026-517 filed. Electrical inspection set for May 20; plumbing rough-in inspection set for May 28. Demolition scheduled for May 27 at 8 AM (paused May 24–26 while user is out of town).
* ✅ (May 17) Agent uploaded revised 3-D kitchen model showing cabinets, backsplash, coffee station, and new faucet.
* ✅ (May 21) Agent uploaded revised floor plan showing countertop, island wine cooler, and lighting scheme.
</observations>

<current-task>
- Primary: Awaiting user review of the latest floor plan and appliance selections, preparing for upcoming demolition on May 27 and June delivery milestones.
</current-task>

<suggestz-response>
- "I've updated the kitchen floor plan and appliance layout. Would you like to review the latest selections or discuss the upcoming demolition schedule?"
</suggestz-response>
